title: Kilo Code
intro: Kilo's CLI (an OpenCode fork) in run mode with JSON events, on an Anthropic-shaped provider. Sessions resume by id; the provider is configured through KILO_CONFIG_CONTENT every turn.

verified.how: hg harness run against DeepSeek, two turns

notes: The provider is Anthropic-shaped (api: anthropic-messages), configured as Kilo's built-in anthropic provider with the gateway as its baseURL.
--auto approves every permission not denied: the platform's sandbox is the boundary.
Kilo's JSON events carry whole parts, not token deltas, so text arrives per completed part.
